# Deep Research Intelligence Packet

## Cycle metadata

- Packet ID: `dr-20260922-0707-candidate-validation`
- Research system: `Codex web research`
- Started at: `2026-09-22 07:07 CDT`
- Completed at: `2026-09-22 07:12 CDT`
- Research scope: Four unresolved rank-1 McDonald's candidate-page validations
- Queue item or vendor: Coates Group, Paytronix, and Restaurant365 candidate pages
- Methodology: Direct retrieval and page-level validation of vendor-hosted source pages; relationship evidence required an explicit product-use or customer indication rather than a brand mention

## Executive result

- Pages reviewed: 4
- Candidate pages validated: 4
- Brand-vendor-product observations added or revised: 3
- Conflicts found: 0
- Material takeaway: Two Coates posts document historical, single-location McDonald's deployments in Dubai and Shenzhen. A current Restaurant365 landing page indicates adoption among unspecified McDonald's owner-operators, but it does not establish corporate procurement, systemwide use, or the identity and McDonald's footprint of the adjacent testimonial operator. The Paytronix page is editorial analysis only.

## Evidence observations

### Observation 1

- Brand: McDonald's
- Vendor: Coates Group
- Product or category: Self-order kiosks, digital menu boards, merchandising screens, and digital drive-thru
- Relationship indication: `customer`
- Deployment scope: `location-level`
- Evidence type: `other`
- Confidence: `90%`
- Confidence rationale: Coates explicitly credits its Dubai team with helping deliver the named products at the relaunched Jumeirah Beach McDonald's restaurant. The source is vendor-owned and highly specific, but it is historical and supports one UAE location rather than a regional or enterprise-wide deployment.
- Source title: Congratulations to the McDonald’s MEA Team
- Source URL: https://coatesgroup.com/insights/blog/congratulations-to-the-mcdonalds-mea-team
- Publisher or source owner: Coates Group
- Published date, if known: 2017-05-17
- Accessed date: `2026-09-22`
- Exact supporting excerpt or faithful factual note: Coates says the relaunched Jumeirah Beach McDonald's in Dubai featured Coates self-order kiosks, digital menu boards, merchandising screens, and digital drive-thru, and thanks the Coates Dubai team for helping bring the project to life.
- Product-specific evidence: Self-order kiosks, digital menu boards, merchandising screens, and digital drive-thru.
- Conflicting or limiting evidence: Historical single-location evidence only; no current-state confirmation and no basis for inferring a UAE, Middle East, or global standard.
- Recommended follow-up: Seek a current McDonald's UAE or Coates regional source confirming whether the deployment remains active or expanded.

### Observation 2

- Brand: McDonald's
- Vendor: Coates Group
- Product or category: Self-order kiosks, indoor and outdoor digital menu boards, Switchboard CMS, and signage
- Relationship indication: `customer`
- Deployment scope: `location-level`
- Evidence type: `other`
- Confidence: `90%`
- Confidence rationale: Coates explicitly identifies its products and its China team's delivery effort at a Shenzhen McDonald's Experience of the Future restaurant. The evidence is specific but historical and location-level.
- Source title: Shenzhen’s Impressive McDonald’s
- Source URL: https://coatesgroup.com/insights/blog/shenzhens-impressive-mcdonalds
- Publisher or source owner: Coates Group
- Published date, if known: 2016-12-15
- Accessed date: `2026-09-22`
- Exact supporting excerpt or faithful factual note: Coates says the Shenzhen restaurant featured Coates self-order kiosks, indoor and outdoor digital menu boards running Switchboard CMS, and refreshed signage, and credits the Coates China team.
- Product-specific evidence: Self-order kiosks, indoor and outdoor digital menu boards, Switchboard CMS, and refreshed signage.
- Conflicting or limiting evidence: Historical single-location evidence only; it does not establish current use or China-wide deployment.
- Recommended follow-up: Seek a current McDonald's China or Coates deployment source with location count and current-state language.

### Observation 3

- Brand: McDonald's
- Vendor: Restaurant365
- Product or category: Restaurant accounting, accounts-payable automation, daily P&L and financial reporting, bank reconciliation, POS and vendor integrations, multi-location and intercompany reporting, asset management, food and labor cost analysis, and training
- Relationship indication: `customer`
- Deployment scope: `franchisee`
- Evidence type: `testimonial`
- Confidence: `45%`
- Confidence rationale: Restaurant365's McDonald's-specific landing page says McDonald's owner-operators choose Restaurant365 and describes relevant workflows. It includes an adjacent testimonial from a 54-location operator, but the retrieved page does not explicitly identify that operator as a McDonald's franchisee or quantify McDonald's locations using the platform. This supports bounded franchisee adoption, not corporate or systemwide deployment.
- Source title: McDonald’s + Restaurant365
- Source URL: https://www.restaurant365.com/blog/restaurant-software-for-mcdonalds-franchisees/
- Publisher or source owner: Restaurant365
- Published date, if known: unknown
- Accessed date: `2026-09-22`
- Exact supporting excerpt or faithful factual note: The page states that McDonald's owner-operators choose Restaurant365 and lists direct POS integration, live P&Ls, partner integrations, multi-location and intercompany reporting, asset management, and actual-versus-theoretical food and labor cost analysis. It also promotes a McDonald's accounting webinar and presents a 54-location operator testimonial without explicitly tying that operator to McDonald's in the retrieved text.
- Product-specific evidence: Accounting, AP automation, daily P&L reporting, bank reconciliation, POS and partner integrations, multi-location reporting, intercompany transactions, asset management, food and labor cost analysis, and training.
- Conflicting or limiting evidence: Vendor sales landing page; no named McDonald's operator is unambiguously linked to the testimonial in the retrieved text, no McDonald's location count is stated, and no corporate endorsement or systemwide procurement is asserted.
- Recommended follow-up: Verify the testimonial operator's brand portfolio from an operator-owned source and seek a named McDonald's franchisee case study with location count.

## Negative findings

- Candidate or claim: McDonald's uses Paytronix for contactless ordering, mobile payments, or loyalty.
- Pages checked: https://www.paytronix.com/blog/mcdonalds-leads-the-way-into-contactless
- Result: The article describes McDonald's own Order & Pay app, drive-thru and curbside workflows, mobile payment, and rewards. It does not say McDonald's uses Paytronix or any Paytronix product; the page is editorial analysis and a lead-in to Paytronix's separate contactless offering.

## Source ledger

| URL | Source type | Accessed | Supports observation(s) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| https://coatesgroup.com/insights/blog/congratulations-to-the-mcdonalds-mea-team | Vendor blog / project note | 2026-09-22 | Observation 1 | Historical single-location Dubai deployment with explicit Coates products. |
| https://coatesgroup.com/insights/blog/shenzhens-impressive-mcdonalds | Vendor blog / project note | 2026-09-22 | Observation 2 | Historical single-location Shenzhen deployment with explicit Coates products and CMS. |
| https://www.paytronix.com/blog/mcdonalds-leads-the-way-into-contactless | Vendor blog | 2026-09-22 | None | Editorial analysis of McDonald's own technology; no Paytronix relationship assertion. |
| https://www.restaurant365.com/blog/restaurant-software-for-mcdonalds-franchisees/ | Vendor landing page / testimonial | 2026-09-22 | Observation 3 | Supports unspecified owner-operator adoption at low confidence; corporate scope and operator identity remain unproven. |

## Research notes and inferences

- Inference: Coates had at least two documented McDonald's location deployments outside Australia by 2017, but these pages cannot establish that either installation remains active in 2026.
- Inference: Restaurant365 appears to market to and serve some McDonald's owner-operators, but the page is insufficient to map a named operator, installed base, or enterprise standard.
- The Paytronix candidate is a false positive created by brand-focused editorial coverage, not customer evidence.
- No finding in this packet should be written directly to canonical account records without the normal RB review step.
